name: vendor-archive-roundtrip-recovery
premise: Rebuild the codec for VARC1, a stateful binary archive container a vendor batch loader produced before the tool was retired. Read the shipped specification and reference files, then write a decoder and a byte-exact encoder that recover captured frames, carry per-stream dictionary and delta state across segment files, keep opaque extensions and non-shortest integers exactly as captured, apply the documented rejection precedence, and resynchronise after in-band damage. Produce the decoded examples and the format, round-trip and error reports.
title: Vendor Archive Roundtrip Recovery

name: schema-migration-plan-repair
premise: Repair a stdlib Python repository that upgrades partner records to canonical schemas through a migration graph. The shipped planner, executor, identity, replay and report modules diverge from a written contract: plans must be searched over schema and field state with a lexicographic tie rule on large graphs, explicit nulls must stay distinct from absent fields, corrections must apply mid-path, and replays must be identified on the record as received. Deliver the patched repository and its reports.
title: Schema Migration Plan Repair
